basic_info.description: First time on the market in decades! This charming three-story Parkside home is ideally located near Taraval Street MUNI lines, Sunset Boulevard transit to SFSU, Stern Grove, Pine Lake Park, Lakeshore Plaza, Lake Merced, the SF Zoo, and a variety of shops and restaurants. The main level features a spacious, light-filled living room with fireplace, formal dining room, large eat-in kitchen, and a generous rear primary suite with full bath (currently staged as a family room). The upper level offers two bright bedrooms and an updated full bath with a double sink vanity. Partial ocean views from the front bedroom while views of the east from the rear bedroom. The ground floor includes additional unwarranted rooms - ideal for guests, office, or creative space - plus one-car garage parking, laundry area, and extra storage. Enjoy the beautifully landscaped backyard with a charming shed, perfect for a home office or studio. A versatile property with room to grow in a sought-after neighborhood!
